book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第四册
unit_cn: Unit 3 Welcome to Dunhuang! 欢迎来到敦煌
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修四 Unit 3 词表(p124-125 真词)+ 本单元主题(敦煌/丝绸之路/文化遗产/中外文化交流)常见课标词;IPA 英音标准词典;例句原创、含目标词、围绕敦煌与丝路文化主题;跳过专有名词(Apsaras/I Ching 等)。

words.example_en: On the Silk Road, Dunhuang was the gateway to and from ancient China.
words.example_cn: 在丝绸之路上,敦煌是进出古代中国的门户。

words.example_en: Tired travellers were glad to see the green oasis of Dunhuang ahead of them.
words.example_cn: 疲惫的旅人很高兴看到前方敦煌这片绿洲。

words.example_en: Dunhuang has a long and glorious history as a centre of exchange.
words.example_cn: 敦煌作为交流中心,有着悠久而辉煌的历史。

words.example_en: The city boasts many sites with UNESCO-protected heritage status.
words.example_cn: 这座城市自豪地拥有许多受联合国教科文组织保护的遗产地。

words.example_en: The Mogao Grottoes were carved out of the rock over a thousand years.
words.example_cn: 莫高窟是历经千年从岩石中开凿出来的。

words.example_en: The paintings are a testimony to how the Silk Road brought East and West together.
words.example_cn: 这些画作证明了丝绸之路如何把东西方联系在一起。

words.example_en: These statues show elements from Ancient Greece, India and Iran.
words.example_cn: 这些雕像融合了古希腊、印度和伊朗的元素。

words.example_en: The murals cover an astonishing area of the cave walls.
words.example_cn: 这些壁画覆盖了洞窟墙壁惊人的面积。

words.example_en: The subjects of the murals vary from religious stories to everyday life.
words.example_cn: 壁画的题材从宗教故事到日常生活,各不相同。

words.example_en: The Apsaras are also called the Flying Immortals.
words.example_cn: 飞天也被称作“飞行的神仙”。

words.example_en: These heavenly musicians and dancers decorate the walls of many caves.
words.example_cn: 这些天国的乐师和舞者装饰着许多洞窟的墙壁。

words.example_en: The painting of Apsaras reached a peak during the Tang Dynasty.
words.example_cn: 飞天绘画在唐代达到了顶峰。

words.example_en: The scrolls describe the wide range of goods traded along the Silk Road.
words.example_cn: 这些卷轴描述了丝绸之路上交易的各种货物。

words.example_en: Goods such as ceramics and medicine passed through Dunhuang.
words.example_cn: 陶瓷和药材等货物曾途经敦煌。

words.example_en: Dunhuang has once again become a global crossroads.
words.example_cn: 敦煌再次成为一个全球汇集地。

words.example_en: Dunhuang hosted the Silk Road International Cultural Expo in 2017.
words.example_cn: 敦煌于2017年举办了丝绸之路国际文化博览会。

words.example_en: The Expo aimed to strengthen cooperation between countries along the route.
words.example_cn: 博览会旨在加强沿线国家之间的合作。

words.example_en: The murals have a coverage of about 45,000 square metres.
words.example_cn: 这些壁画的覆盖范围约为45,000平方米。

words.example_en: Qian Zhongshu was a renowned scholar and writer.
words.example_cn: 钱钟书是一位著名的学者和作家。

words.example_en: He was accepted into the foreign languages department at the university.
words.example_cn: 他被这所大学的外语系录取了。

words.example_en: The Confucius Institute promotes Chinese language and culture abroad.
words.example_cn: 孔子学院在海外推广汉语和中国文化。

words.example_en: Four Sinologists shared their love of Chinese literature with us.
words.example_cn: 四位汉学家与我们分享了他们对中国文学的热爱。

words.example_en: The film The Shaolin Temple made him fall in love with China.
words.example_cn: 电影《少林寺》让他爱上了中国。

words.example_en: He simply loved the film's theme tune.
words.example_cn: 他特别喜欢这部电影的主题曲。

words.example_en: The theme song was called Song of the Shepherd.
words.example_cn: 那首主题歌叫《牧羊曲》。

words.example_en: Sima Qian is known as China's Grand Historian.
words.example_cn: 司马迁被誉为中国的“太史公”。

words.example_en: He had little prior knowledge of classical Chinese works.
words.example_cn: 他对中国古典作品几乎没有先前的了解。

words.example_en: Prior to reading Records of the Grand Historian, he knew only Western classics.
words.example_cn: 在读《史记》之前,他只知道西方经典。

words.example_en: After reading the book, he realised the true genius of Sima Qian.
words.example_cn: 读完那本书后,他领会到司马迁真正的天才。

words.example_en: He was determined to translate Dream of the Red Chamber into his own language.
words.example_cn: 他下定决心把《红楼梦》翻译成自己的语言。

words.phrase_en: The Romance of the Three Kingdoms
words.example_en: His next goal was to translate The Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
words.example_cn: 他的下一个目标是翻译《三国演义》。

words.example_en: The story of the Three Kingdoms is loved by readers around the world.
words.example_cn: 三国的故事深受世界各地读者喜爱。

words.example_en: Thirty-six Stratagems has sold more than a thousand copies in Bulgaria.
words.example_cn: 《三十六计》在保加利亚已售出一千多册。

words.example_en: Broadway is famous for its enormous and colourful signs.
words.example_cn: 百老汇以其巨大而彩色的招牌而闻名。

words.example_en: Dunhuang boasts sites with UNESCO-protected heritage status.
words.example_cn: 敦煌拥有受联合国教科文组织保护的遗产地。

words.example_en: Dunhuang was a green island in the middle of the desert.
words.example_cn: 敦煌曾是沙漠中央的一座绿色岛屿。

words.example_en: Silk and other goods travelled along the ancient Silk Road.
words.example_cn: 丝绸和其他货物沿着古老的丝绸之路运送。

words.example_en: The Silk Road was a famous trade route between East and West.
words.example_cn: 丝绸之路是连接东西方的著名贸易路线。

words.example_en: When the trade routes changed, the city became far less busy.
words.example_cn: 当贸易路线改变后,这座城市远不如从前繁忙。

words.example_en: Dunhuang was a centre of cultural exchange for many centuries.
words.example_cn: 数百年来,敦煌一直是文化交流的中心。

words.example_en: These ancient caves are more than a thousand years old.
words.example_cn: 这些古老的洞窟已有一千多年的历史。

words.example_en: These hidden treasures give us a picture of old Dunhuang.
words.example_cn: 这些隐藏的珍宝让我们得以一窥昔日的敦煌。

words.example_en: Why the Library Cave was sealed up still remains a mystery.
words.example_cn: 藏经洞为何被封存至今仍是一个谜。

words.example_en: Thousands of manuscripts were hidden inside the Library Cave.
words.example_cn: 成千上万的手稿藏在藏经洞内。

words.example_en: Its long history shows the significance of Dunhuang on the Silk Road.
words.example_cn: 悠久的历史显示出敦煌在丝绸之路上的重要性。

words.example_en: Today Dunhuang is a world-class tourist destination.
words.example_cn: 如今敦煌是世界级的旅游目的地。

words.example_en: The Expo aimed to strengthen mutual cooperation between countries.
words.example_cn: 博览会旨在加强国家之间的相互合作。

words.example_en: Countries along the route built closer cooperation through the Expo.
words.example_cn: 沿线国家通过博览会建立了更紧密的合作。

words.example_en: Dunhuang was once a prosperous city on the trade route.
words.example_cn: 敦煌曾是贸易路线上一座繁荣的城市。

words.example_en: The theme of the Expo was to promote cultural exchange.
words.example_cn: 博览会的主题是促进文化交流。
